title: Microbial cfDNA Library Preparation and Sequencing with Oxford Nanopore
author: Martin Schou Pedersen
materials: NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme
Before starting, take out 96-well plate cold block, 2 mL tube cold block, and AmpureXP beads. Prepare all thermocycler programs beforehand.
Thaw NEB Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix, EDTA, and Native Barcodes. Keep on ice. Centrifuge Ligase Master Mix and barcodes briefly.

steps.title: DNA Repair
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA repair reaction in a PCR plate for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Combine 15–30 ng cfDNA, 46 µL FFPE DNA Repair Buffer v2, and 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix v2.
If normalizing between samples, add nuclease-free H₂O to bring all samples to 46 µL input.
Mix 10× by pipetting and centrifuge plate briefly.
Run thermocycler program cfDNA-repair: 37°C for 15 min (lid 50°C), then 4°C hold.

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform proteinase K digestion to remove repair enzymes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate and place on a cold block.
Add 2 µL NEBNext Proteinase K directly to each well.
Mix 10× and centrifuge briefly.
Run thermocycler program cfDNA-proteinaseK: 37°C for 15 min (lid 75°C) → 65°C for 5 min → 4°C hold.

steps.title: End Prep
steps.instruction: Perform end-repair and A-tailing of the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge plate and place on a cold block.
Add 3 µL NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix to each well.
Mix 10× and centrifuge briefly.
Run thermocycler program cfDNA-end-prep: 20°C for 30 min (lid 75°C) → 65°C for 30 min → 4°C hold.
Remove plate from thermocycler, centrifuge briefly, and place on ice block.

steps.title: End-Prep Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the end-prepped DNA using AmpureXP beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL 80% ethanol (8 mL 100% EtOH + 2 mL water) and label 2 mL LoBind tubes.
Add 180 µL AmpureXP beads per sample into individual 2 mL LoBind tubes.
Add 60 µL of end-prepped DNA to the beads and mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, flicking/inverting approximately every minute.
Add 10 µL nuclease-free water and gently resuspend with P10 or P50 pipette set to 7 µL.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet until liquid is clear.
Centrifuge briefly, return to magnet, and remove last traces of ethanol with a 10 µL tip.
Remove supernatant, add 200 µL 80% ethanol, remove supernatant, and repeat the wash once more.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet for 1 minute.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer supernatant (containing DNA) to a new 2 mL LoBind tube. DNA can be stored at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Barcode Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate unique barcodes to the DNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 7.5 µL eluted DNA and 2.5 µL of a unique barcode (NB01–NB96) to each tube.
Gently mix reactions with P50/P100 pipette set to 12 µL and record barcode usage.
Add 10 µL Ligase Master Mix (previously mixed by pipetting) to each tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes. While incubating, set Thermomixer to 37°C.
Add 4 µL EDTA (blue cap) to each reaction and mix.
Incubate at 37°C on Thermomixer for 10 minutes, flicking tube gently for ~10 seconds every 2 minutes.

steps.title: Barcode Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the barcoded DNA and pool samples.

substeps.instruction: Pool all barcoded samples into one 2 mL LoBind tube.
Add 3× AmpureXP volume per sample (e.g., 6 samples = 360 µL beads: (20 µL × 3) × 6).
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add 35 µL nuclease-free water and gently resuspend with P50 pipette set to 25 µL.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet until liquid is clear.
Remove supernatant, centrifuge briefly, return to magnet, and remove last traces of supernatant with a 10 µL tip.
Remove supernatant, add 600 µL SFB, wait 30 seconds, and remove supernatant.
Repeat the SFB wash: add 600 µL SFB, wait 30 seconds, and remove supernatant.
Transfer supernatant to a new 2 mL LoBind tube.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet for 1 minute.

steps.title: DNA Quantification (Post-Barcode)
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the barcoded pool.

substeps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with Qubit using 2 µL input. Expected yield: 15–40 ng total.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate native adapters to the barcoded pool.

substeps.instruction: Thaw and place on ice: NEBNext Quick Ligation Buffer, SFB, Quick T4 DNA Ligase, Native Adapter (NA), and Elution Buffer (EB).
Vortex Ligation Buffer for up to 39 seconds before use.
In a 2 mL LoBind tube, combine: 30 µL Barcoded pool, 5 µL Native adapter (NA), 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Buffer, and 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of the sequencing library.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL AmpureXP beads (3x), mix by pipetting, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet until liquid is clear.
Remove supernatant, take tube off magnet, add 125 µL SFB, resuspend, centrifuge briefly, and place on magnet until clear.
Repeat the SFB wash: remove supernatant, add 125 µL SFB, resuspend, centrifuge briefly, and place on magnet until clear.
Remove supernatant and use a P10 pipette tip to remove the last traces.
Take tube off magnet, add 34 µL EB (black cap), and resuspend.
Incubate tube at 37°C on the Thermomixer for 10 minutes, flicking gently every 2 minutes.
Centrifuge briefly and place on magnet for at least 1 minute.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library and store it.

substeps.instruction: Measure DNA with Qubit using 2 µL input. Expected yield: ~10 ng total (0.4 ng/µL).
Transfer supernatant (finished library) to a new 2 mL LoBind tube labeled 'cfDNA library' with date on cap.
Store library at 4°C until loading.

steps.title: Flow Cell Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the PromethION flow cell for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Allow PromethION flow cell to reach room temperature for at least 20 minutes.
Thaw, mix, and keep on ice: Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Beads (LIB), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF).
Prepare priming mix: add 30 µL FCT to a new FCF tube (1170 µL) for each flow cell. Keep on ice.
Insert flow cell into PromethION 2 Solo and start flow cell check in MinKNOW.
Check for condensation, remove liquid, and verify heat pad is intact. Ensure >5000 pores.
Wait at least 20 minutes before starting sequencing.

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the library and start the sequencing run.

substeps.instruction: Prepare loading mix in a 2 mL LoBind tube: 100 µL SB, 68 µL LIB, 32 µL Prepared library.
Open the priming port (clockwise).
Set a P1000 pipette to 200 µL. Remove air from port by inserting tip and turning volume to 220 µL gently.
Load 200 µL loading mix with a P1000. Close port and attach light shield.
Load 500 µL priming mix to complete priming and wait 5 minutes.
Start sequencing run in MinKNOW with: Super-accurate Basecalling (SUP), no short read filter, PHRED score > 10, and run duration of 96 hours.
